editorial.blurb: A beloved 40-year family operation serving authentically spiced Thai food with the warmth of home cooking.
editorial.insiderTip: They only do takeout 4–8 PM, so plan ahead—and if you spot watermelon in season, ask; they hand it out occasionally as a seasonal treat.

topDishes.note: Herb-loaded and refreshing, with a ceviche-like quality and naturally sweet shrimp
Smoky grilled beef in addictive sauce with toasted rice
